trip_01_korea_japan: Day 1: Arrive Busan, settle into the Airbnb, evening walk at Haeundae Beach. Day 2: Haedong Yonggungsa Temple in the morning, then a day trip out to Gyeongju to see Bulguksa Temple. Day 3: Busan Blue Line Park sky capsule (one group booking for all 7), SEA LIFE Busan Aquarium, then KTX up to Seoul in the evening. Day 4: Full day at Nami Island. Day 5: Gyeongbokgung Palace, Bukchon Hanok Village, National Folk Museum, and the War Memorial of Korea — a full day of culture. Day 6: Full day at Seoraksan National Park. Day 7: Changdeokgung Palace, Insadong, and dinner at Gwangjang Market. Day 8: Morning flight to Fukuoka, transfer to Hiroshima, afternoon free. Day 9: Ferry to Miyajima for Itsukushima Shrine, back to the mainland and on to Osaka the same night. Day 10: Osaka Castle, then Umeda Sky Building at sunset. Day 11–12: Two full days at Universal Studios Japan on the 2-day pass. Day 13: Dotonbori and Nippombashi for arcades and shopping. Day 14: Kyoto — Fushimi Inari Shrine in the morning, Kiyomizu-dera in the afternoon. Day 15: Nijo Castle, the samurai sword experience, Ninja & Samurai Museum, and Nishiki Market. Day 16: Nanzen-ji and Saiho-ji Temples. Day 17: Flight to Sapporo, afternoon at the Open Air Art Museum. Day 18: Free day at an onsen ryokan. Day 19: Tokyo — Ghibli Museum in the morning, Asakusa and Gundam Base in the afternoon. Day 20: Akihabara, Pokémon Center Shibuya, Sensoji Temple. Day 21: Shibuya Crossing, Harajuku, Tokyo Tower. Day 22: Depart for home.
trip_02_europa_solo_iberia_uk: Madrid (29 Mar–04 Apr): Prado, Palacio Real, Reina Sofía on Tuesday morning, Templo de Debod, Retiro Park, Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor on the free days. Lisbon (04–10 Apr): Belém tram loop for the Tower, Jerónimos and the monument to the Discoveries; Alfama and Castelo de São Jorge; Baixa and the Santa Justa lift. Sintra (10–11 Apr): a single full day combining Palácio da Pena, Castelo dos Mouros, Quinta da Regaleira and Palácio de Monserrat via local buses, then straight on to Porto. Porto (11–15 Apr): Livraria Lello, Torre dos Clérigos, Ribeira, Taylor's Port Cellars. Bordeaux (15–19 Apr): Cité du Vin, Place de la Bourse, Cathédrale Saint-André, Tour Pey-Berland. Bruges and Ghent (19–24 Apr): canal walks, Belfry, Gravensteen Castle, Sint-Baafs Cathedral. Edinburgh (24–28 Apr): Edinburgh Castle, Royal Mile, Real Mary King's Close, Arthur's Seat. London (28 Apr–04 May): Westminster Abbey, Tower of London, Changing of the Guard, Sky Garden, Big Ben exterior. Cologne, Prague, Vienna, Salzburg (04–25 May): cathedral and old-town circuits in each city, two museums per day cap. Plitvice (25–27 May): full day on the K route. Split and Dubrovnik (27 May–10 Jun): Diocletian's Palace, Krka day trip, Old Town Walls walked around midday between the two Lokrum ferry crossings. Return via Barcelona for Sagrada Família on 27 Jun.
trip_03_europa_2019_islands: 20–22 Sep: Arrive Venice, two days covering San Marco, the Rialto Bridge, the Grand Canal and the Jewish Ghetto, then a late flight to Athens. 23–24 Sep: Acropolis, Plaka, Ancient Agora, Temple of Olympian Zeus, overnight ferry to Santorini. 25 Sep: Santorini for the day, buy the next island-hop ticket on arrival at the port. 26 Sep: Ferry to Milos, afternoon at Sarakiniko. 27 Sep: Ferry to Naxos, old town and beaches. 28 Sep: Ferry to Mykonos, Chora in the evening. 29 Sep: Early flight to Budapest, Parliament and the Chain Bridge in the afternoon. 30 Sep–01 Oct: Fisherman's Bastion, Gellért Baths, overnight bus to Kraków. 02–04 Oct: Main Market Square, Kazimierz, and a combined Auschwitz-Birkenau plus Wieliczka Salt Mines day tour along with the Schindler's Factory museum on the same afternoon. 05 Oct: Flight to Rome. 06–08 Oct: three days around the historic center, overnight bus to Zagreb. 09–10 Oct: Zagreb old town, day trip to Plitvice Lakes on the local bus timetable. 11 Oct: Flight to Paris. 12–13 Oct: Eiffel Tower, Sainte-Chapelle, the Catacombs. 14 Oct: Depart for home.
